items.name: Riverwatch Hold
items.identity_summary: A stone river fort that pays for disciplined levy rotations and signal-line archers.
items.strategic_summary: Riverwatch anchors the western crossings; if it stands, Embercourt can still reset the road war around a disciplined river line.

logistics_plan.vulnerability_summary: If Riverwatch loses its linked yard, signal post, or sanctum, the river line cannot cycle reserves cleanly.

items.name: Duskfen Bastion
items.identity_summary: A hidden marsh mustering point that swells raider bands before they hit the roads.
items.strategic_summary: Duskfen is the oath-host's first mustering basin; if it holds, Mireclaw keeps feeding cutters into every nearby road.

logistics_plan.vulnerability_summary: If Duskfen loses its kennel, drum post, or shrine lane, the marsh musters stop arriving in step.

items.name: Blackfen Gate
items.identity_summary: A fortified choke point built around missile nests and a constant trickle of fresh raiders.

items.name: Highwater Keep
items.identity_summary: A mill-fed keep whose watchfires and grain levies keep the basin's roadwardens in the field.
items.strategic_summary: Highwater is Embercourt's basin capital. Once its charter bastion is complete, the keep can sustain reserve columns and a final roadward push.

logistics_plan.vulnerability_summary: If Highwater's basin yard, signal post, or sanctum line is cut, the charter reserve schedule slips and the final push slows.

items.name: Murkward Ford
items.identity_summary: A toll-ford stockade built on drowned pilings, pushing cutters and slingers toward every nearby crossing.

items.name: Reedbarrow Ferry
items.identity_summary: A drum-marked ferry port whose log booms and fish racks keep the covenant moving between channels.
items.strategic_summary: Reedbarrow's ferry booms keep the covenant stitched together; if the port survives, Mireclaw can reopen the marsh lanes fast.

logistics_plan.vulnerability_summary: If Reedbarrow loses its kennel runs, drum post, or reedscript shrine, the ferry lanes recover too slowly to keep the marsh open.

items.name: Nightglass Redoubt
items.identity_summary: A shrine-redoubt cut from black reedstone where the covenant hoards its last reserves and drum-fires.
items.strategic_summary: Nightglass is the covenant's capital redoubt. A completed dominion ring lets it drive ferry raids, elite packs, and a last marsh surge.

logistics_plan.vulnerability_summary: If Nightglass loses its kennel, drum outpost, or shrine line, the dominion ring cannot keep ferries, packs, and drums aligned.

items.name: Prismhearth
items.identity_summary: A buried relay city whose shard yards and cloisters turn spell discipline into steady battle tempo.
items.strategic_summary: Prismhearth is the Compact's relay capital. If its daybreak matrix comes online, Sunvault can turn the front into a full-theater firing network.

logistics_plan.vulnerability_summary: If Prismhearth loses its lens house, relay post, or sanctum circuit, the daybreak arrays cannot keep their batteries synchronized.

items.name: Halo Spire
items.identity_summary: A high relay crown whose galleries, duel courts, and batteries reward prepared lanes and stacked battle magic.
items.strategic_summary: Halo Spire is Sunvault's forward crown; if it stays lit, the Compact can relay reserves and battery fire far beyond the immediate line.

logistics_plan.vulnerability_summary: If Halo Spire loses its lens house, relay line, or sanctum, the forward batteries lose clean reserve timing.

items.name: Graftroot Caravan
items.identity_summary: A migratory orchard-fort of seed vaults, graft halls, and bramble toll roads.
items.strategic_summary: A migratory orchard-fort of seed vaults, graft halls, and bramble toll roads.

logistics_plan.vulnerability_summary: This seed town has no scenario placement yet; logistics hooks are authored for future integration.

items.name: Orevein Gantry
items.identity_summary: A contract foundry town of ore lifts, pressure rails, furnace chapels, and brass gantries.
items.strategic_summary: A contract foundry town of ore lifts, pressure rails, furnace chapels, and brass gantries.

logistics_plan.vulnerability_summary: This seed town has no scenario placement yet; logistics hooks are authored for future integration.

items.name: Bellwake Harbor
items.identity_summary: A fog harbor of bell docks, mirror slips, obituary vaults, and black-sail moorings.
items.strategic_summary: A fog harbor of bell docks, mirror slips, obituary vaults, and black-sail moorings.

logistics_plan.vulnerability_summary: Bellwake depends on its wreck ledger, memory-salt pan, and fog-buoy approaches; losing those routes exposes the harbor's long build chain.

items.name: Rootgate Nursery
items.identity_summary: A rooted toll nursery that hardens living roads, grows recovery yards, and feeds Thornwake border claims.
items.strategic_summary: Rootgate Nursery turns contested roads into slow recovery ground for Concord wardens and bramble escorts.

logistics_plan.vulnerability_summary: The nursery depends on nearby copses and bramble hedges; losing those sites leaves the root road thin.

items.name: Clauseworks Depot
items.identity_summary: A railhead depot where ore clauses, rivet kennels, and furnace pavises protect Combine extraction claims.
items.strategic_summary: Clauseworks Depot converts ridge quarries into stubborn contract lines and measured siege pressure.

logistics_plan.vulnerability_summary: The depot is rich in ore but slow to replace crews if the quarry and gatehouse routes are cut.

items.name: Fogchart Mooring
items.identity_summary: A hidden bell mooring that trades salvage charts, mourner lanterns, and black-sail escorts for sudden map reach.
items.strategic_summary: Fogchart Mooring gives Veilmourn a compact forward harbor for scouting, salvage income, and raiding crews.

logistics_plan.vulnerability_summary: The mooring needs pilot houses and lighthouses nearby; without them its fog routes collapse into a thin garrison.

items.name: Cinderlock Bastion
items.identity_summary: A canal-lock citadel that turns charter tolls and beacon discipline into fast, well-supplied road columns.
items.strategic_summary: Cinderlock controls the ember canal and gives Embercourt a hard western hinge for levy, artillery, and relief traffic.

logistics_plan.vulnerability_summary: Without nearby support yards and signal posts, the lock fort loses the reserve tempo that makes its canal line formidable.

items.name: Dawnmirror Observatory
items.identity_summary: A sunrise observatory whose great mirror funds harmonic wards, prism cadres, and calibrated aurora artillery.
items.strategic_summary: Dawnmirror gives Sunvault a long-view bastion that couples magical study to disciplined ranged defense.

logistics_plan.vulnerability_summary: The observatory depends on lens relays and pilgrim roads; isolated, its delicate calibration cannot support the outer batteries.

items.name: Briarwheel Enclave
items.identity_summary: A migrating ring of living roots that grows thorn companies, sporeglass medicine, and road-ready garden stores.
items.strategic_summary: Briarwheel lets Thornwake move a durable nursery front along threatened roads without surrendering deep-grove support.

logistics_plan.vulnerability_summary: The root wheel needs orchard, shrine, and outpost anchors; sever those links and its living road becomes a stranded thicket.

items.name: Cindercoil Foundry
items.identity_summary: A pressure-coil foundry that exchanges ore and furnace heat for armored crews, boiler guns, and relentless production.
items.strategic_summary: Cindercoil gives Brasshollow a fortified manufacturing heart able to replace heavy losses along the contract road.

logistics_plan.vulnerability_summary: The foundry consumes ore, ledgers, and cooling water at scale; losing its linked depots turns the coil into a brittle furnace.

items.name: Gloamwake Anchorage
items.identity_summary: A ribbed ghost-dock whose bell rites, salvage contracts, and fogglass slips muster hard-hitting wake companies.
items.strategic_summary: Gloamwake gives Veilmourn a defensible inland anchorage for refitting corsairs and sounding deeper fog routes.

logistics_plan.vulnerability_summary: The anchorage needs salvage posts, shrines, and pilot marks; stripped of them, its great rib-dock becomes an empty memorial.
